name: Mammoths

variantInfo.name: Mammoth
notes: Found in the Wilderness south-east of Ferox Enclave.
Uses a stab melee attack (max hit about 7); has no elemental weakness and very low defensive bonuses.
Krystilia counts only these Wilderness mammoths.

locationComparison.name: Wilderness (south-east of Ferox Enclave)
notes: Mammoths roam the Wilderness south-east of Ferox Enclave.
Their high HP makes this an efficient Dwarf multicannon spot; a nearby altar gives unlimited Prayer and Ferox Enclave is a short resupply walk.
Easily safespotted behind the many trees and tree stumps thanks to their 3x3 size.
Wilderness area: beware player killers and avoid carrying excess supplies.

taskNotes: SYNTHETIC slayerTargetId 265 (252-305 C2/C3 block): the real SLAYER_TARGET varp for Mammoths is not wiki-published; QA live-verify.
Krystilia assigns mammoths as a Wilderness-only task; only the Wilderness mammoths (south-east of Ferox Enclave) count.
Mammoths have no elemental weakness and very low defensive bonuses, so any strong weapon is effective.
Mammoths use a stab melee attack with a max hit of about 7.
The spawn area is in the Wilderness; keep low-risk gear and a one-click escape teleport ready.
recommendedMethod: Kill mammoths in the Wilderness south-east of Ferox Enclave with any strong melee weapon such as Viggora's chainmace; they have no elemental weakness and negligible defence, so speed and survivability matter most. Wear low-risk gear and keep a one-click escape teleport ready.
